build_document_backend: build a document backend class that extends AbstractDocumentBackend to parse document formats
test_is_valid: test the is_valid method to check if a document backend instance is valid
test_supported_formats: test the supported_formats class method to get supported input formats
test_supports_pagination: test the supports_pagination class method to check pagination support
run_convert: run the convert method on a DeclarativeDocumentBackend to produce a DoclingDocument
